title: Support Ticket Completion Certification OpenAPI Precision V2

phases.objective: Recover the exact legacy completion-certification operation as one reviewed Support Ticket path-item reference while preserving current main tests and failing closed for every other imprecise operation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the recovered Support Ticket runtime contract helper and precise registry writer against a temporary copy of the actual root OpenAPI document.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact legacy completion-certification operation becomes the reviewed local path-item reference, current Support Ticket sync regressions still pass, and check mode is idempotent.
steps: Load the exact reviewed source recovery without replacing the current main integration test file.
Run the existing Support Ticket runtime OpenAPI synchronization regression.
Copy the actual root OpenAPI, registry, and route source into an isolated temporary directory.
Run precise registry write mode and verify the exact reviewed completion-certification reference.
Run precise registry check mode and verify no remaining drift.
assertions: Only the explicitly allowlisted legacy completion-certification signature may receive the metadata-only upgrade.
Parameters, request body, responses, descriptions, and consequential classification are preserved.
Every non-allowlisted imprecise operation remains rejected.
The actual root document succeeds, not only an isolated synthetic operation fixture.
No repository mutation, provider dispatch, credential access, external send, deployment, or secret output occurs.
